SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER,
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.FUEL_SURCHARGE_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.LINE_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.LINEHAUL_REVENUE + NVL(FREIGHT_BILLING.ACCESSORIAL_REVENUE,0))
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS,
  CNR_FIN.FREIGHT_BILLING  FREIGHT_BILLING
WHERE
  ( FREIGHT_BILLING.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER

SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER,
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_JOURNAL_LINES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 5200 AND 5299 THEN GL_JOURNAL_LINES.EXPENSE_AMOUNT END)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS,
  CNR_FIN.GL_JOURNAL_LINES  GL_JOURNAL_LINES
WHERE
  ( GL_JOURNAL_LINES.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER
